Built for USDC on Arc

Arc exposes USDC in two precisions: native transfers use 18 decimals; the ERC-20 interface uses 6. ArcReceipt reads official transfer events, avoids counting the same payment twice, and shows gas separately.

What this receipt proves

It checks transaction, receipt and canonical block data returned by Arc’s public RPC. Finality is reported when the RPC’s finalized block covers this transaction. This is not an independent cryptographic proof, a net balance statement or proof that an invoice has only been paid once.

Supported: official USDC transfer events and ordinary top-level native transfers. Internal native transfers without supported events are not inferred. The query goes directly from your browser to Arc’s RPC. No payment history is stored by this app.
